_meta.status: PARTIAL — session budget exhausted after the domain-resolution pass and the site-probe pass. Only sources that were individually fetched, confirmed HTTP 200 at the final URL and term-matched are included here.
_meta.note: Every URL below was fetched with curl -sL -4 --compressed using a desktop Chrome user-agent and returned HTTP 200 at the final URL recorded. No URL was constructed from a pattern and left unopened.
_meta.next_session_resume: Score order, next unstarted brand after this batch's probe pass: celestial-seasonings(68) onward. Probe output for 22 brands already collected in /tmp/probe1.txt and /tmp/probe2.txt (see lead report for the discovered candidate URLs per brand).

domain_findings.curie: getcurie.com returns HTTP 200 with a bare 'Coming Soon — getcurie.com — We're under construction' placeholder (95 chars of text, no products). curiebody.com fails TLS (handshake_failure, curl 000); curie.co serves a Shopify SEO agency site ('Curie — Your Shopify Store Is Invisible to ChatGPT'); curiebrand.com returns Cloudflare 1016 origin DNS error; curiebeauty.com does not resolve. Recommendation: keep the row, treat the brand as not currently trading, do not cite any of these domains.
domain_findings.aday: aday.com redirects to a VC application form; the brand's own store was thisisaday.com, which now answers HTTP 301 to https but fails the TLS handshake (OpenSSL alert 40) — a closed Shopify storefront. Wayback has a snapshot of www.thisisaday.com from 2026-04-27, so the storefront was live until roughly mid-2026. Recommendation: brand appears wound down; no authentic live domain.
domain_findings.amour-vert: amourvert.com 301s to amourvert.co, which carries the title 'Amour Vert | The Original Sustainable Fashion Brand In USA' but whose body is a celebrity/gossip SEO farm (Amber Heard, Sydney Sweeney, 'How to Create Stickers as a Printable PDF By Amour Vert'). Wikipedia has no article on the brand (404). Recommendation: classify the brand as defunct and do not cite amourvert.co.

wrong_domain_findings.a-good-company: agoodcompany.com is a gift-certificate storefront ('Good Company Certificates'), NOT the Swedish sustainable-products brand. The real brand site is agood.com (HTTP 200, 'Eco-Friendly Phone Cases, Stone Paper Notebooks, Reusable Bottles – agood company'). DB row needs fixing before sourcing.
wrong_domain_findings.thought-clothing: thoughtclothing.com fails (curl 000). wearethought.com redirects to thoughtsocks.com, which carries the title 'Sustainability Should be a Joy | Thought Clothing' — that is the brand's live store.

blocked.music-magpie: musicmagpie.co.uk returns HTTP 403 'Just a moment...' (Cloudflare) to curl for both the homepage and the sitemap.
blocked.hain: hain.com (Celestial Seasonings' parent) homepage is fetchable (200) but the fetched text contains no sustainability content; celestialseasonings.com's Shopify sitemap exposes only product/collection/policy pages, no sustainability or CSR page.
